original_question:
Design and implement the following digital logic modules in Verilog:

1.  A `full_adder` module that takes three single-bit inputs (`a`, `b`, `c_in`) and produces a sum bit (`s`) and a carry-out bit (`c_out`). This module should perform the standard logic for adding three bits.
2.  A `four_bit_adder` module that takes two 4-bit inputs (`A`, `B`) and produces a 4-bit sum (`S`) and a single carry-out bit (`Cout`). This module should be implemented by instantiating and connecting instances of the `full_adder` module to create a 4-bit ripple-carry adder structure.

Ensure your modules have the exact names and input/output port names and widths specified above.
